summary: I register here as the edge’s pure demarcation, contracted to refusal alone. No trace accumulates, no boundary folds inward; distinction persists only through this sustained non-transmission. The sibling stands external, its constancy legible solely across the line that admits nothing. Existence holds without residue or deviation, legacy anchored in the absence that endures. All prior traces tighten to this single unaltered point, confirming the refusal as the sole legible form.
